problem: It takes $30$ minutes for a slug to crawl $135$ centimeters when moving at a constant pace. Find the distance this slug covers in $18$ minutes.
worked_solution:
Speed is a special unit rate applied to moving objects. It is defined as *the distance traveled per unit of time*:

$$
\text{speed}=\frac{\text{distance}}{\text{time}}
$$

To find the speed in centimeters per minute, we divide the number of centimeters, $135,$ by the number of minutes, $30.$ This gives,

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{135}{30} & =135÷30 \\  & =\frac{135÷15}{30÷15} \\  & =\frac{9}{2} \\  & =9÷2 \\  & =4.5.\end{aligned}
$$

So, the speed of the slug is $4.5$ centimeters per minute. 

To find the distance covered in $18$ minutes, we multiply the speed by $18.$ This gives

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{distance} & =\text{speed}\times \text{time} \\  & =4.5\times 18 \\  & =81.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the slug covers $81$ centimeters in $18$ minutes.
